'''R2-I2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who was captured by the giant [[Droid/Legends|droid]] known as the [[Great Heep]] on [[Biitu]]. The droid likely survived it's captivity.<ref name="The Great Heep" />
